notes.title: pixelBOT EXTREME! Couch Coop
notes.notes: Watch the devs setting a new Speedrun record!

notes.title: EXTREME! update v1.5.0: Couch Co-Op and Difficulty selection!
notes.notes:
[h1]Content updates[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b]: Local co-op mode - Team up with a friend, share the 4 rocket colors and beat the levels together!
[*][b]NEW[/b]: Difficulty selection - Choose your preferred difficulty (easy, normal, hard) in the main menu or on the map at any time and feel the difference!
[*][b]UPDATED[/b]: All levels incl. boss levels got a little polish and finetuning to offer you an awesome experience!
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes and improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*]Reworked / Enabled keyboard controls in Single- and Multiplayer!
[*]Full controller support in Single- and Multiplayer!
[*]Improved particle effects and animations!
[*]Lots of minor tweaks and fixes that improve the overall gameplay experience!
[/list]

notes.title: EXTREME! update v1.2.1: Wake up, pixelBOT!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]STORY PIECES[/b] added! Plus helpful buttons overlay and fancy FX![/h1]

[b]Content updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Story intro in lvl1-1! Get briefed and GIVE IT ALL!
[*] [b]UPDATED[/b]: Optional colored buttons overlay: Switch on/off a helpful buttons overlay supporting you in getting the rocket colors right!
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes and improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved flashes and fade FX thanks to DOTween!
[*] Improved tutorial flow!
[*] Fixed a strange respawn starting bug in lvl1-4!
[/list]

notes.title: EXTREME! update v1.2.0: EXTREMELY hot summer!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]FINETUNE[/b] your perfect pixelBOT gameplay experience![/h1]

Summer 2019 brings new intense [b]gameplay options[/b] and loads of improvements and bug fixes!

[b]Content updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Adjustable game speed: Find your right pace and slow down in EXTREME! sections!
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Shields: Turn on 'orbs give shields' in the settings to get a lifesaver for a collected orb!
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Destroy last option: Decide if the last or even last 3 obstacles touched should be destroyed after respawn!
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Shooting overlay: Switch on/off a helpful buttons overlay if playing with a controller!
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Adjust your volume: Finally audio volume can be turned down/up in the settings!
[*] Reworked world 1 once again to optimize gameplay experience!
[*] 1st boss level now has a checkpoint!
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes and improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the annoying cam scrolling bug in lvl1-1 and reworked ingame camera scrolling!
[*] Fixed time counting issues and implemented a new way to properly count play time!
[*] More explosive breakOUT!
[*] Improved tutorial flow!
[*] Adjusted controls screen in the settings!
[*] Direct restart in boss levels!
[*] New particles for collecting bullets, orbs and letters!
[*] Optimized gameplay for 21:9!
[*] Slight UI adjustments!
[/list]

notes.title: EXTREME! update v1.1.0: TRICK or TREAT!
notes.notes:
[h1]More [b]ACTION[/b]! More [b]CONTROL[/b]! More [b]AWESOMENESS[/b]![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32522443/83ca5eb9bff0171d3fe3e690f1786d394136212d.png[/img]

With the Halloween 2018 update we adjusted world 1 completely and moved our [b]colorful gameplay twist[/b] right to the start of the game!

[b]Content updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked world 1: [b]Shoot right from the start[/b]!
[*] [b]Early gameplay twist[/b]: Collect your first two rockets in levels 1-1 and 1-2!
[*] React and [b]shoot faster[/b]: Increased shooting rate!
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Auto-shooting option in the settings!
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Play with one hand: If auto-shooting, use LB or ALT to switch between your rockets!
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Two gravity options: Flappy (High gravity) and Weightless (low gravity)!
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Level loading screen incl. useful tips and tricks!
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Keyboard players without a NUMPAD: Use arrow keys to shoot!
[*] Reworked some EXTREME! levels to achieve the ultimate challenge!
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes and improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved tutorials!
[*] Fixed the "cam starting bug" - no more dying at the very first start!
[*] Improved camera scrolling on the world map!
[*] Lower orb requirements at world map barriers!
[/list]

notes.title: EXTREME! update v1.0.3: MAC VERSION finally playable!
notes.notes:
[h1]pixelBOT running on MacOS![/h1]
[b]Blast your way through on Windows and Mac![/b]
[*]Fixed strange issues with Mac version and made pixelBOT running on Mac!
[*]Fixed some controls navigation issues on the world map!

notes.title: EXTREME! update v1.0.2: SPEEDRUN MODE!
notes.notes:
[h1]SPEEDRUN mode included![/h1]
[b]beat the game and become the fastest BOT ever![/b]
[list][*]updated level and global stats!
[*]added total record!
[*]added hit accuracy rate!
[*]added a way to skip level stats!
[*]more keyboard controls: arrows vs. numpad!
[*]cosmetic improvements and slight UI changes!
[/list]

notes.title: EXTREME! update v1.0.1: A NEW BEGINNING!
notes.notes:
[h1]EXTREME! improvements + much more BOOM! waiting for you:[/h1]
[list][*]finetuned buttons sensitivity, BOT weight + gravity to achieve more feasible controls!
[*]pimped up world 1 - shoot 'em up earlier + way more frequent!
[*]spiced up some levels to have EXTREMEly intense feelings!
[*]polished background scrolling + fixed some flickerung issues!
[*]exchanged death wall graphics!
[*]PLUS slightly faster movement!
